inlines.v: SUBSTAN'TIAL, adjective Belonging to substance; real; actually existing. If this atheist would have his chance to be a real and substantial agent, he is more stupid than the vulgar. 1. Real; solid; true; not seeming or imaginary. If happiness be a substantial good. The substantial ornaments of virtue. 2. Corporeal; material. The rainbow appears like a substantial arch in the sky. 3. Having substance; strong; stout; solid; as substantial cloth; a substantial fence or gate. 4. Possessed of goods or estate; responsible; moderately wealthy; as a substantial freeholder or farmer; a substantial citizen.
